bounded_authority: This is a specification for the root's later staging. No shared renderer, checker, schema, site, tracker, Git, deployment or release was changed.

field_mapping.title: Use the exact published title for h1, document title, citation_title and ScholarlyArticle headline.
field_mapping.description: Use the unique description for search, Open Graph and structured data.
field_mapping.abstract: Preserve the full original one-paragraph abstract, with all sentences and qualifications, as indexable HTML and ScholarlyArticle.abstract.
field_mapping.abstract_heading: Display Original abstract. The current shared renderer hardcodes Abstract and ignores this field; root must make a bounded per-page adaptation without rewriting the abstract.
field_mapping.result: The precise result; retain fixed H, independent standard equal-H components, n observations EACH, terminal T, every T/n/F and the explicit positive constant.
field_mapping.why_it_works: Why the result holds; keep the short mathematical explanation and established canonical-area input, with no internal verification narrative.
field_mapping.limitations: Scope and limitations; retain all exclusions and both antisymmetric normalization factors.
field_mapping.ai_disclosure: Status and AI use; extensive AI assistance, unrefereed status, no human peer-review or formal certification claim.
field_mapping.edition_note: Keep declared 14 October 2026/version1.0 distinct from record creation 17 October 2026 UTC; no priority inference.
field_mapping.background: Linked prior work, including Brownian/smooth rates, Fourier/Gaussian antecedents, and bounded Dickinson/Jackowski implications.
field_mapping.related_resources: The complete unchanged ZIP has local and original Zenodo links; do not omit this supporting-material section.
field_mapping.collaboration: Passive professional invitation; actual research/writing contributions and mutual agreement. No individual outreach.
field_mapping.canonical_url: The final slug-derived URL belongs in canonical, Open Graph, structured data, citation PDF URL, research index and sitemap when actually staged.
field_mapping.source_binding: Private identity/custody metadata; not public article text.
field_mapping.review_metadata: Private editorial state; not public article text.

custom_verdict_requirements.root_authority: promotion.status=PASS is copied from the later root scientific clearance with SHA256 86a8ceed51423cf9c79c71b41389c644361d9b75b54b6bce9093ff9fa0307e8d. It is not an editorial render/live/browser/native-tracker PASS.
custom_verdict_requirements.scope_original: Preserve the exact complete verdict: SCOPE_COMPLETE_ATTRIBUTION_QUALIFIED_MATHEMATICAL_GATE_PENDING, mathematical_verdict=null, substantive_defect_found=null, promotion_authorized=false, and article_candidate_status=HELD_PENDING_SEPARATE_MATHEMATICAL_GATE. Its separately copied root_disposition is SCOPE_COMPLETE.
custom_verdict_requirements.analytic_original: Preserve the complete original object, including status=COMPLETE, verdict=PASS, precise_gap=null, publication_clearance_claimed=false and the explicit excluded-H=1 review self-correction. Do not remove the preserved correction record or change any sealed bytes.
custom_verdict_requirements.adversarial_original: Preserve the exact custom verdict NO_SUBSTANTIVE_DEFECT_OR_UNRESOLVED_CENTRAL_GAP_FOUND, exact_remaining_central_gap=null and publication_clearance=false. Do not manufacture a status=PASS field inside that object.
custom_verdict_requirements.chronology: The later root scope_gate_resolution resolves the original pending mathematical gate without retroactively changing the scope candidate or reviewer objects. All complete original objects are embedded unchanged in promotion.json.

receipt_requirements.identity: The complete original receipt object and complete file-entry objects are preserved in promotion.json; the original file is unchanged.
receipt_requirements.record_shape: The receipt has record_raw_sha256, not record_sha256. Bind sources/record.json separately by its own SHA256; do not mutate or fabricate a field in the frozen receipt.
receipt_requirements.asset_shape: The standard file entries use name/url/bytes/md5/sha256/zenodo_checksum. The shared asset normalizer supports this shape; no source normalizer change is required.

asset_specification.pdf: Use the unchanged sources/paper.pdf for the local iframe and direct-open link. Add an explicit local PDF download link with the download attribute. Retain a clear original Zenodo PDF link. Never regenerate the PDF.
asset_specification.supplement: Copy the complete PR1071_preprint_v1_0_support.zip unchanged. Provide local download and original Zenodo ZIP links; do not extract, trim or repack the public supplement.
asset_specification.reader_identity: The ZIP's paper.pdf equals the standalone seven-page PDF byte-for-byte. There is only one unique reader and no nested archive.
asset_specification.download_adapter: The current shared renderer limits explicit local PDF download attributes to paper23203100. Root must add this page's direct-download behavior and verify the actual rendered output. public-sections.json records the exact intended links and iframe specification.
asset_specification.no_extra_assets: No additional reader or ignored third-party primary-cache files are public assets.

metadata_specification.author: Alec Kriebel
metadata_specification.scholarly_graph: Exact title, author/ORCID, declared date/version, DOI, complete original abstract, free-access status, PDF encoding and unrefereed status. Internal review timestamps, hashes and counts stay private.
metadata_specification.citation: citation_title, citation_author, citation_author_orcid, citation_publication_date=2026/10/14, citation_doi and canonical-local citation_pdf_url; BibTeX identifies version1.0 and the declared edition date.
metadata_specification.discovery: Add the one final canonical page to /research/ index and scholarly ItemList and the research sitemap only during authorized staging; check the final URL, internal links and indexable prose.

layout: Use the established plain personal blog template: white background, readable single column, straightforward typography, ordinary links and simple headings. No new site framework or heavy visual element.
remaining_root_gates: Read the complete REPORT, PUBLIC_COPY, public-sections, configs, adapter and seal before stage authorization.
Inspect actual rendered public prose, metadata, full abstract, links and copied asset identity.
Complete local and live HTTP/asset checks.
Populate native Sheet AA canonical URL only after verified live.
